build.deepgemm_source: sanitized DeepGEMM export via DEEPGEMM_SRC_DIR and VLLM_DEEPGEMM_SRC
build.public_source_builder: disabled in this tool; resolved non-wheel PyPI artifacts must already exist as Pixi/uv cached wheels
build.vllm_version_source: DSV4_VLLM_WHEEL_VERSION override, otherwise git describe --tags --long --match v[0-9]*

runtime_notes: Docker install uses pip --no-index --no-deps from the recorded wheelhouse.
pip check is intentionally not part of the image build because the local FlashInfer override can differ from vLLM's upstream metadata pin.
FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK defaults to 1 in the image and entrypoint because the resolved flashinfer-cubin package can lag the local FlashInfer source version.
CUTLASS DSL 4.5 base and cu13 wheels overlap files; image install force-reinstalls nvidia-cutlass-dsl-libs-cu13 last and validates the cu13 overlay.
